meta.privacy_policy: All personal, owner, and parcel-identifying data are anonymized with placeholders ([REDACTED-PROPERTY-01], [REDACTED-OWNER-01], [REDACTED-LEASE-01]). Unverified private/parcel values are strictly blank ('').
meta.verification_rule: Every row links to an official primary source in data/sources.json. Verified rows contain exact values read from the official source on 2026-11-07; unverified rows have blank value cells and are published on flagged.html.

rows.metric: Subject Property Street Address, Legal Description & Parcel Identifier ([REDACTED-PROPERTY-01])

rows.metric: Exact NNN Lease Expiration Date within 2030–2035 Window ([REDACTED-LEASE-01])
